text_block_list.name: トーセンジョーダン
text_block_list.text:
ふぅ～……。
っし、まあ今日はこんなもんか～。

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Have you been practicing that the whole time?

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, ayyy. Yeah yeah, a pal's birthday party is coming up soon~.
I'm gonna blow their minds with this!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Though honestly, even Espo-san dropped by.
Feels like it's just been one thing after another like this today.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's that supposed to mean, 'even you'...?

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, wanna hear? It's hilarious, honestly~...

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Umm, first juggle normally, and from there catch behind the back... alright!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Argh.
Gah~, this really is crazy hard~...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Jordan-san!
...You've been practicing so earnestly this entire time, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, please have this for your break!
If you run into any trouble, I'll do whatever I can to help!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
For real?! Heheh, thanks a bunch~
Buena-chan, you're literally a lifesaver~

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Um.
Is there anything I might be able to help with as well?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Furioso-san too?!
That'd be super helpful, but like, are you really sure?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I cannot simply ignore a fellow horse girl practicing so earnestly.
...That is the pride of Funabashi, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... thanks! In that case,
lemme know if anything looks off, okay?
'Cause I'm gonna juggle!

Step right up, gather round, ladies and gents!
The Jordan Theater is officially in session~!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Salted, cheese, scallop, and squid ink!
Grab your favorite flavor and enjoy the show, ya bastards~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold up! What do you think you're doing?!
And don't just randomly start hawking popcorn next to me!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, I'm drummin' up an audience for ya, ain't I?
An entertainer only gets better when eyes are on 'em, ya know!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If you can't even win over a crowd...
how d'ya expect to move your bestie to tears on her birthday?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
! ...Whoa.
Wait, why did that actually kinda touch my heart...?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, then I guess I gotta give it everything!
Heheh, you better give me a round of applause when I pull it off!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...I somewhat feel as though we're dancing in the palm of Golshi-san's hand, but...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, but Jordan-san is totally fired up now.
All's well that ends well, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, that's how it went down~ and then Espo-san showed up too, right?
Like, didn't way too many people come? Hilarious.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, everyone's just so super nice, y'know?
They just happened to be passing by and still treated me so kindly~

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
...The hell you mean, you think that was just a coincidence?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: No matter how you look at it, they came specifically to see you, dumbass!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Sheesh... nobody could just leave you alone *because* it was you.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Even though nobody asked ya to, you bust your ass going all out for your friend.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
That's the kind of person you are, so of course folks wanna lend a hand.
...Not that I'd know, though!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Seriously... you're honest to a fault, girl.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hah?! Wait, why are you calling me dumb?!
Ugggghhh!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Still... is that so?
...Heheh, so that's how it is~♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm kinda feeling super motivated now.
...Alright, guess I'll get in a little more practice!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"—Ayyy, happy birthday!
Let's get hyped with my show!"

text_block_list.name: Birthday Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, incredible...!
Jordan, you could do this kind of stuff?!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Heheh, that's nothing yet!
I'm gonna blow your mind even more, just watch!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph, looks like everyone's hyped up.
Guess ya did pretty decent after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the academy grounds,
I happened to spot two horse girls
looking at a video on a smartphone.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Right, right?! Isn't this insane?!
...Ah, that reminds me—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I gotta blast this to everyone!
To Buena-chan, Furioso-san, right?
And Golshi, and then—
